rationale: The agent appears to have canceled the order with reason "no longer needed" without presenting any authentication step, without confirming the change with the user, and without showing evidence that it checked whether a 10x zoom option exists or its price. The user’s instruction prioritized verifying zoom, modifying the item to 10x if available, or canceling only under specific conditions; the agent did not attempt modification and chose a cancellation reason that is unsupported by tool results. This constitutes an order-changing write without confirmation and actions not aligned with the user’s conditional instructions, thus failing the policy and the task requirements.
